question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

____ she was partly deaf, she was a gifted pianist.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**although**" is used to introduce a contrast or concession between two statements. (हालांकि)
 
• In the sentence,** "Although she was partly deaf, she was a gifted pianist," **the word **"although"** appropriately introduces the surprising fact that despite being partly deaf, she had an exceptional talent.
 
• The other options: "**until**," "**because**," and "**yet**" do not fit the context as effectively.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** ***Although **she was partly deaf, she was a gifted pianist.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Until (जब तक)**: used to indicate the continuation of a state or action up to a certain point in time.
 
• **Because (क्योंकि)**: used to give a reason for something.
 
• **Yet (फिर भी)**: used to introduce something contrasting with what has just been mentioned, but less appropriate in this context compared to "although."
